messages:
Maya (AE): Zenith says they're ready to sign but procurement returned a long DPA with HSM and residency asks. Need a clear path for PO ingestion + signature.
Jordan (Legal): Main redlines: mandatory EU residency, HSM attestation on letterhead, and a 30-day SLA cure window they insist on. We'll propose 45 days and tweak the indemnity carveout.
Rafael (Finance): AP requires a one-line JSON orderform we can send back pre-filled. Also need remit-to, VAT, and PO number field. Net30 vs Net45? We can accept Net30 for enterprise if billing contact is invoices@zenith.co.
Leah (SE): For HSM: Dedicated supports BYOK; Hosted uses our Thales HSM. We can produce an attestation letter within 3 bd for standard request. If they want module certs (FIPS), add 7-10 bd. Recommend including an "attestation_pending" flag in the orderform.
Zenith Procurement: Order import expects: customer, po_number, sku, region, qty, monthly_price, billing_contact. Region must be eu-central-1. SLA target 99.9 required by security.
Maya (AE): Quick JSON example to paste into their AP: ```json
{"customer":"Zenith Ltd","po_number":"<PO>","sku":"RD-Dedicated","region":"eu-central-1","qty":3,"monthly_price":"90000","billing_contact":"invoices@zenith.co","support_sla":"99.9","kms_mode":"BYOK|vendor-hsm","attestation_pending":"true"}
```
Jordan (Legal): I'll upload the MSA patch with alternate indemnity language and DPA exhibit. docs-bot: uploaded /contracts/Zenith/MSA_v2.pdf by @Jordan.
docs-bot: File: MSA_v2.pdf (uploaded) reviewer=Jordan (Legal).
Rafael (Finance): Once PO + JSON received, send invoice to invoices@zenith.co and cc finance@redwood.com. I'll set Net30 for this customer.
Maya (AE): Plan: 1) Jordan posts MSA/DPA patch today; 2) I send JSON & DocuSign envelope to their signer; 3) Rafael finalizes billing when PO arrives. Will update when envelope sent. :thumbsup:
